performance_case.causal_mechanism: Prospective pre-dispatch classification authority plus post-result Manager acceptance prevents outcome-time selection, duplicate inflation and hidden Local learning while preserving the sole clock and sole canonical writer.
performance_case.claim_boundary: Acceptance can prove only the closed two-stage schema, exact transitive and Git-object validation, deterministic raw and unique-family counts, offline failure behavior and no-write scope. It cannot prove research quality, independent alpha, prediction, fees, slippage, utilization, capacity, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, R2 completion, candidate readiness, OOS, deployment or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because this offline verifier cannot execute or promote a strategy. Any later drawdown benefit remains MISSING_PROOF until a separately preregistered candidate passes matched-capital forward evidence.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A four-file pure verifier costs one bounded Local cycle and two small prospective Manager records per accepted output, but avoids a larger report integration, a second writer and continued overcounting of nested evidence families.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL is unchanged; deterministic classification should reduce repeated research and make useful mechanism conclusions and capability slices visible sooner, shortening time to the next falsifiable strategy question.
